reviewed_by: Written by Claude from the receipt photo and the maintainer's 2026-10-31 Dell rerun (RL-000073 updated: 11 rows, 48.71 taxed at 8.25%). The maintainer confirmed LDSSGLZH0NBN = 2.00 from the photo on 2026-11-02.
known_issue: RL-68 (was RL-38): four faded rows (LDSSGLZH0NBN, CHEESECAKE 6.72, GLASS WIPES, second FRENCH BREAD) have no readable price in OCR; the parser offers them as missing-item lines and the reviewer adds them by hand.
layout_notes: Walmart layout: name, 12-digit UPC, F flag, price, tax flag (N/X). Print is faded in the top rows.
